messages.task:
You are a financial data analyst working with a set of programmatic tools that can look up information in a synthetic finance database.

Scenario
--------
18 2015 annual report performance graph – the following chart presents a comparison for the five-year period ended June 30 2015 of the market performance of the company’s common stock, the S&P 500 index and an index of peer companies selected by the company.  This comparison assumes $100 was invested on June 30 2010 and all dividends were reinvested.  Total returns are calculated according to market capitalisation of peer-group members at the beginning of each period.  Peer companies are in the business of providing specialised computer software, hardware and related services to financial institutions and other businesses (ACI Worldwide, Bottomline Technology, Broadridge Financial Solutions, Cardtronics, Convergys, CoreLogic, DST Systems, Euronet Worldwide, Fair Isaac, Fidelity National Information Services, Fiserv, Global Payments, Heartland Payment Systems, MoneyGram International, SS&C Technologies Holdings, Total Systems Services, Tyler Technologies, VeriFone Systems, WEX).  (The numerical values from the chart are not shown here.)

Tools you can call
------------------
1. list_entities() -> list[str]
   Return the names of every entity stored in the database.
2. get_entity_id(entity_name: str) -> int | None
   Convert a human-readable entity name to its internal identifier.
3. get_entity_category(entity_name: str) -> str | None
   Get the category (“index”, “company”, etc.) for an entity.
4. list_years() -> list[int]
   Return all calendar years contained in the database.
5. get_year_id(year: int) -> int | None
   Convert a calendar year (e.g. 2011) to its internal identifier.
6. get_return_series_value(entity_id: int, year_id: int, series_type: str) -> float | None
   Fetch a numeric value from the return_series table.  Typical series_type values include "cumulative", "price", and "dividend_yield".
7. compute_percentage_change(start_value: float, end_value: float) -> float
   Arithmetic helper that returns the percentage change from start to end, rounded to one decimal place.
8. get_noise_metric(entity_id: int, metric_name: str) -> float | None
   Retrieve a miscellaneous financial metric (not usually relevant to return calculations).

Question
--------
What was the percentage change in the 5-year annual performance of the peer-group stock from 2010 to 2011?

Instructions
------------
• Decide which tools you need in order to answer the question.  You may call them multiple times.
• Show your reasoning, call the tools, and finally provide a concise answer as a standalone line that can be checked automatically (e.g. "8.3%" without additional text).
